schemeContent.briefDescription: The Department of Higher Education, Government of Madhya Pradesh has created this new scholarship scheme available for candidates belonging to the General categories.

children.text: The "Vikramaditya Yojana" is a scholarship scheme offered by the Government of Madhya Pradesh. This scheme is presented by the Department of Higher Education, which means it is intended to help students who are pursuing further education after successfully completing Class 12. These scholarship opportunities are available only for candidates belonging to the General category, which is one of the most important aspects of this scheme.
